Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recoredd statement concerns the collision you reported
at an intersection in Pearland, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: Sure. I'd rather keep my name off the recording, if that's okay. I'm the driver of the vehicle that was hit on the
driver's side.
Q: That's fine. We'll note you as the claimant driver. Can you walk me through what happened before the impact?
A: I was heading through the intersection on a green light. I'd slowed a little because traffic was backed up on the
cross street. Then a pickup came in from the left and didn't stop for its red light. It hit my door pretty hard.
Q: Did you see the pickup before it entered the intersection?
A: Not really. I glanced left when I was about to go and I didn't see anything coming. It was only a second or two
before the impact.
Q: After the collision, did you remain at the scene?
A: Yes. I stayed put until the police arrived. An officer took down my information and the other driver's, and I gave a
short statement there.
Q: Have you been seen by a medical provider since the accident?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same afternoon. My right knee took most of the force when it hit the console and the
door frame. It's swollen and I can't fully straighten it. They ordered an X-ray and told me to follow up with an
orthopedic doctor.
Q: Are you currently receiving treatment for the knee?
A: I'm going to physical therapy twice a week and I'm uisng a brace when I walk. Some days I can't drive for long
because my leg aches.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add about the collision or your injuries?
A: Just that I'm trying to get back to normal. I want the claim handled fairly, and I'll send over my treatment records as
soon as I have them.
Q: Understood. This concludes the recorded statement. Thank you.
</page>
